versions.changelog:
Initial release of llm-inference-radar skill.

- Provides a workflow and ruleset for building research intelligence radars focused on LLM inference acceleration, AI infra, model serving, and related areas.
- Emphasizes use of primary sources and reproducibility, discouraging amplification of unverified or media-only claims.
- Outlines structured processes for generating daily briefs, paper radars, open-source/infra watches, horizon scanning, and knowledge base updates.
- Includes specific classification, evidence, and formatting standards to ensure credible and traceable outputs.
- Supports persistent knowledge tracking and integration of user feedback into research processes and configurations.
